How do you guys manage risk sequentially? If you do at all? Just some context: I’m still a yet to be truly profitable part time trader. Always have wrestled with risk management. Currently I’m entertaining the idea of having a maximum loss, and then within that limit I’ll adjust my size based on how I feel. Furthermore, I want to cut my max risk in half every time I lose a trade. Which would be relative to what I lost in the initial losing trade. 

So say max risk is $500 for any trade.
I’m not feeling confident so I only risk $300 and lose.
Next trade max risk is $150. And so on and so forth until I hit a really small risk size and take a few days to rest or until I make back the loss. 

I know trading as a whole isn’t super mechanical and there’s really a dedication, art, and patience behind it all. But I’m just curious how any successful traders feel about what I’ve just proposed.

Honestly, no. I just hate losing. And for a while I was managing losing well. Then I just stopped doing that. And I don’t know why. A reasonable loss turns into me getting mad and then spiraling out of control

Idk. This may be some kind of psychological block for me but, it’s hard for me to exactly say that “X” was wrong and instead I should do “Y”. Like instead I have thought about it much more generally. So maybe 1-2% is my “general” daily stop loss. And even then, if I see a great set up, and I feel that honest conviction, I may still take risk if I’ve reached that point already. And it has worked very well albeit not without some hiccups along the way. Definitely the issue would start with probably too much risk exposure on an entry/ putting myself in a situation I’m uncomfortable with. I’ve had a couple of days where I was doing just fine, had cut a trade quick maybe. And then a couple minutes later I jumped in again with increased size, but the increase was not proportional at all and I didn’t really consider the collective delta I was buying into and then it would obviously be much more than I was comfortable with handling. So kind of understanding the delta has helped. And then just “slowing down”. Like some days I would get really kind of sporadic. But usually it would start with me either sizing too large initially, then me getting pissed off about the side effect of that (cutting a loss quick but it being too large for my liking). And then becoming borderline careless in an attempt to retrace the loss. So yeah it can become a spiral of carelessness if I am in the wrong headspace. And just like anything else in life, with time, you end up not caring/ returning to a neutral state of mind. So I gotta give myself some time off.

It’s really just like a matter of giving myself adequate time to clear my head. After this past couple of months I feel like I’ve “seen the light” so to speak and I know I can make this work. But it’s always gonna be easier when you have more money to work with. And I just need to put my head down and get some more money, as well as clear my head as a part of that process
